primary_purpose: Freeze a bounded, executable before-image of the LOGOS Missing Link admission contract and distinguish that reproduction from a claim about general LLM abduction.
claim_boundary: Configuration-contract reproduction only. No general LLM capability, biomedical discovery, paper-thesis, or world-model sufficiency claim is made.

api_summary.title: Missing Link admission contract — executable dogfood audit
api_summary.brief: A characterization test reproduces a 0-acceptance before-image and a biomedical threshold collision; this is a repository-contract finding, not an LLM capability verdict.
api_summary.summary: TOE-TEST-0060 executes the upstream Missing Link characterization test, hashes its paper copy and code/config inputs, and freezes the observed contract. The run reproduces 12 generated candidates, 0 accepted candidates, and a biomedical profile whose shared overlap metric yields an empty feasible region. Its verdict is ABSTAIN because the source worktree is dirty and the probe cannot establish a general claim about abduction or scientific discovery.
findings: CHAR-011 reproduced 12 generated candidates and 0 accepted candidates under the recorded shipped configuration.
CHAR-012 reproduced an empty biomedical feasible region: max_single >= 0.92 and max_single <= 0.90.
The recorded test passing means the defect before-image was reproduced; it is not a product PASS or a model-capability result.
A future repair needs an after-image that attributes grounding, omega, and novelty changes separately.
